messages.text: Can we clear Redstone for onboarding? I need the exact watchlist release on record.
I checked the Q2 watchlist against Redstone’s supplier record. I found no match.
Please pin the Q2 release. The supplier approval must point to this check, so a new list will send it back to us.
I’ll cite this check on the supplier review, with Q2 as the evidence.
Rowan, pull the audit for Redstone. Which evidence can we rely on for supplier onboarding?
I found the Redstone quality audit. I’ve attached that audit to this decision.
Use it for supplier quality. I’ll have the lot team make its own premium-channel decision.
I’ll carry the audit reference into the onboarding draft.
Cedar, review the terms against the version procurement has on file.
The terms I’m proposing are from the signed-off draft labeled v3. It’s the version attached here.
Keep the contract acceptance separate from the watchlist check. We need both on the supplier decision.
I’ll link this contract review as its own prerequisite.
Before procurement sets a volume, can we confirm that Block C clears the forest-origin policy?
I found the Block C imagery and the v2 forest-origin policy. Both refer to the plot in the supplier record.
Please record the clearance for Block C specifically. Our volume approval will cite that plot release.
I’ve attached both inputs to the plot review for sign-off.
Can we approve Redstone for the Q3 sourcing plan? Bring the required onboarding checks into this thread.
I’ve linked the watchlist check, quality review, contract acceptance, and Block C clearance.
The watchlist clearance is tied to Q2. The supplier approval needs revalidation if that source changes.
I’ll record supplier approval as the proposed decision. The volume allocation stays a separate decision and can cite this one.
Can we allocate 1,200 tonnes of Q3 apples to Redstone? Check the threshold before I confirm.
The allocation relies on Redstone’s supplier approval and a current release for Block C. I’ve linked both.
At 1,200 tonnes the forest-origin release is mandatory. Keep it as a direct citation even though onboarding also cites it.
I checked both dependencies for this allocation and will flag it if either one falls out of date.
Can LOT-441 go to the premium channel? I need the quality and sourcing links on the same record.
I’ve pulled the Redstone quality decision and the Q3 allocation for the lot review.
The allocation applies to this supplier. If that decision is reopened, bring this certification back for review too.
I’ll draft the lot certification against those two decision versions.
